profiles.name: Efficient
profiles.traits: High achieving. Logical, fact-based decisions. Thinks outside the box, but only after fully understanding what is not working. Needs facts and time to be persuaded, and does not like to be rushed. More task-focused than people-focused.

profiles.name: Driven
profiles.tagline: Executes the Plan, Controls the Environment, Get Er’ Done
profiles.traits: Born leader who loves to be in charge. Wants immediate results and the bottom line, RIGHT NOW. Decisive, may not consult others. Not afraid of pressure or confrontation. Wants directives followed.

profiles.name: Persuasive
profiles.tagline: Strong Communicator, Enthusiastic, Likes to Try New Things
profiles.traits: Accomplishes goals by rallying people. Loves new ideas and testing them. Can be competitive. Wants to be heard and appreciated for ideas.

profiles.name: Relational
profiles.tagline: The Connector, Brings Everyone Together, Lover of Life & People
profiles.traits: Motivates others and needs fun or recognition. Avoids confrontation, fine print, and follow-through. Wants to be involved in decisions.

profiles.name: Peace Keeping
profiles.tagline: Team Player, Loves to Serve Others, Thrives in Harmony
profiles.traits: Coach and counselor. Loves teamwork, security, and harmony. Dislikes conflict. Assists someone else’s vision. Needs clear communication and time for change.

profiles.name: Steady
profiles.tagline: Steady, Loyal, Reliable, Gets Along with Everyone
profiles.traits: Loyal above all. Needs time to process change. Avoids confrontation and quick decisions. Great listener. Wants to be valued for their viewpoint.

profiles.name: Coordinating
profiles.tagline: Diplomatic, Loves to Analyze, Rule Follower
profiles.traits: Accuracy, rules, and standards. Task-oriented and does not like to be rushed. Needs time to process before acting. Creates order and roles. Facts over feelings.

profiles.name: Accurate
profiles.tagline: No Detail Is Missed, There Is a “Right” Way, Values Facts and Expertise
profiles.traits: Careful, intentional decisions. Do it right the first time. Needs a non-critical atmosphere. Freezes up in confrontation. Slows down under pressure.
